what_constrained: The emulator initially retained a different face, and early motion captures included partial redraws; the store dashboard converted the optional animated banner to PNG.
what_worked: Host-tested roll math, 10 Hz batched sampling, settled native captures, an upright first GIF frame, independent release review, and public listing verification.
what_differently: Exercise Clay Save and battery/readability on a physical Pebble Time 2 before making hardware claims.
